hook: Stop pouring your pasta water down the sink immediately because that cloudy liquid is hiding the ultimate restaurant emulsion secret.
body: Every single time you dump your pasta, you are draining away the natural starch that binds oil and liquid into a glossy, velvety sauce. Instead of relying on heavy cream, scoop out a half cup before draining. Toss your cooked noodles back in the pan with your sauce and a splash of that magic water, then stir vigorously over heat. It emulsifies instantly, coating every strand like you are sitting in a Roman trattoria.
cta: Save this video for the next time your pasta sauce turns out watery.
